extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians and other contributors interested in Polymath collaborative projects (people who want to read, propose, or participate in Polymath projects via the wiki)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and minimal operational rules for using the Polymath project wiki: how to propose projects, where to post suggestions (logo), and site policies about editing, account creation, and image uploads to reduce spam.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anonymous editing policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Anonymous editing has been disabled to help combat spam; a captcha system was added to hinder automated account creation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If disabling anonymous editing or the captcha is causing problems for legitimate contributors, contact the site administrator at thomas@asone.ai for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account creation / site lockdown policy
rubrics_metrics.description: The wiki may be locked down temporarily in response to major influxes of spam (example: locked down July 29, 2013).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you would like an account set up while the wiki is locked, email thomas@asone.ai; the administrator will try to reply quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image upload policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Image uploads have been disabled because they were causing problems with spam.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need to upload an image despite the restriction, contact thomas@asone.ai to arrange an upload.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to propose a Polymath project
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have a tentative proposal for a polymath project, you may either make a post on your own blog or place the proposal on the Polymath wiki.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A (partial) list of proposed projects and links is provided on the wiki; use the provided proposal pages or links to present and discuss your idea.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo suggestions procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: A Polymath logo is being trialled; suggestions for the logo should be submitted on the logo page or discussed at Talk:logo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add suggestions directly to the logo page on the wiki or join the conversation on the logo talk page.
